narrative.text: Craig Henderson contributed to TrueSight DAO and the 20250617_beerhall project with four entries from June 2024 to April 2025. His contributions centered on providing liquidity, earning 1 TDG for every 1 USD injected in three instances, alongside one entry for human effort at 100 TDG per hour.
